verdict.rationale: Outlook is an email service, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence documents only the Microsoft Graph mail REST API, which is a developer building block. The single community mention of an LLM with an 'MCP/cloud integration' does not identify an official Outlook MCP server, so there is no evidence the product ships one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
